intro: Everything between deciding what to make and the finished goods reaching stock: what a product is made of and how, the plants, machines and people that make it, production orders and the shop floor, quality checks, and what each job cost. Larger jobs run as projects, with tasks, risks and a budget.
start: Set up your plants and work centres in Manufacturing › Resources, with each work centre's working hours.
Add your machines and the people on the floor, with the skills each person holds.
Make a bill of materials and a routing for each product you make, and release them.
Make your first production order, plan it and release it to the floor.
Let operators do the work from My work. Stock moves and the cost builds up as they report.

articles.summary: Say what is checked and how much of a lot, and record each reading. The inspection passes or fails on its own rules.

articles.after: While an in-process inspection waits or has failed, the next operation cannot start. While a final one waits, the finished goods are not received.
tips: Let it go on (waive) lets a lot go on without passing. The reason is kept.
Traceability shows what went into a product, or where a lot went. Choose which way, then press Trace it.
